title: Chapter 251: Inside Story 1
content:
Chapter 251: Inside Story 1

With the statements of Xiaoyaozi and Master Ban, it can be said that Zhong Yu has achieved most of its goals. As for the remaining farmer, Tian Guang, it doesn't matter if he agrees or not.

For Zhong Yu, the Taoist and Mohist refuges are much more important than that farm family.

Among them, the Mohist school has the mechanism skills that Zhong Yu desperately needs now. If there is the support of the Mohist's mechanism skills, then the current shortcomings of the Yu Kingdom in war machinery will be greatly supplemented.

In fact, for Zhong Yu, he is more inclined to choose the Gongshu family who specializes in offense.

It's just helpless, the Gongshu family is an extremely important force in Qin's hands, and almost all of Qin's war machines come from the Gongshu family.

Faced with such an extremely important force, Qin State naturally guarded against it. Not only did it have countless supervising troops on the surface, but also buried countless spies in the dark to monitor the movements of the Gongshu family. It is to prevent the Gongshu family from rebelling against Qin, or being hijacked by the dark forces of other countries.

With the Qin State, the guardian of the once most powerful country in the world, Zhong Yu naturally has no way to take back the world's number one overbearing organ art inheritance family from Qin State.

And because of the help of the mechanism technique, Qin State is always at a disadvantage on the battlefield, and I don't know how much advantage it has.

Not to mention anything else, let's just talk about the central battlefield. In any previous battle, the coalition forces did not suffer from this mechanism.

Often, as soon as the Qin army's mechanism beasts entered the field, the morale of the coalition forces would drop sharply, the casualties would increase greatly, and the losses would suddenly increase a lot. It can be seen from this that the Gongshu family's tricks have an extremely important impact on the situation on the battlefield, and they are deeply feared by Zhong Yu.

Now that we have encountered setbacks, we must naturally find ways to overcome them and find other ways to face this problem.

As a time traveler, Zhong Yu naturally immediately thought of the Mo family, who had a feud with the Gongshu family.

These two organ inheritors, as the two most powerful organ arts in the world, naturally have reasons for being praised.

The Gongshu family is known for their domineering mechanism techniques, and they claim that they can attack cities and villages on the battlefield, and breaking the army and trapping the battle is invincible. Facts in the past have also proved this point, as can be seen from the tens of thousands of soldiers who died in this mechanism in the coalition forces.

As the Mohist family, which is as famous as the Gongshu family, naturally has its own characteristics. That is the world-famous non-offensive mechanism technique. He is famous for his powerful defense. In terms of defense, it can be said that no one can match him.

In fact, for Zhong Yu, the so-called defensive mechanism technique is not too important. The reason why he values Mohism so much is mainly because of his mechanism beast.

Although the Mohists claim to be non-offensive, they advocate defense and hope that the world will be peaceful. But in fact, the Mohism's mechanism technique is not all defensive, but also offensive.

Just like the green dragon and white tiger among the four great organ beasts of the Mohist school, needless to say, the white tiger, as the king on the ground, is used to fight against the organ snakes of the Gongshu family without losing the slightest advantage.

And the legendary green dragon, which is more secretive, seems to be able to collapse a hill with one blow and destroy thousands of lives, and its power is extremely powerful. Even if it may have the defect of insufficient mobility, it is still a terrifying monster that makes people fear.

Get rid of these, even without these powerful weapons, with the joining of the Mohists, the production of Yuguo's military industry can be greatly improved. A master swordsmith like Master Xu has forged several swords that are famous all over the world. There are also many ordinary disciples of the Mohist school, all of them are skilled craftsmen, with their support, the quality of Yuguo's weapons will definitely be improved by several levels.

So for Yuguo, with the joining of the Mo family, at least it can increase the strength of Yuguo by nearly 10%.

Don't underestimate the strength of this tenth, you must know that Yuguo's current territory is vast and its population is large, it can be said to be the best in the world. Even today's Qin State, after successive wars, has lost land and lost its population, it is no longer comparable to the Yu State.

As far as this tenth of the strength is converted into absolute military strength, it is equivalent to an army of nearly 200,000.

Such a number is almost equivalent to a Yan country.

Therefore, this can predict why Zhong Yu is so eager for the Mohists. Not only is the Mohist's own large number of people, and his world-renowned reputation, but also the potential it brings, and the ready-made power that can be used at any time.

What's more, as an empire that wants to conquer the existence of the heavens and myriad worlds in the future, it is naturally impossible for Zhong Yu to act like a lone ranger and do everything by himself, such as refining alchemy, training weapons, searching for resources, and so on.

There are countless subordinates under his command, waiting to serve him at any time. These subordinates can not only bring him a large amount of supplies and help him deal with countless troubles, but also consume a lot of reserves.

Among them is this weapon, and it is still a big head, which wears out extremely quickly.

Therefore, with the help of the Mohists, it will definitely greatly reduce the pressure on the Imperial Military Weapons Supervision. Moreover, the mechanism technique of the Mohist school is already close to the legendary weapon training.

Even in some aspects, it is even more powerful than some lower cultivation tools. With the help of the Mohists, and a thorough understanding of their technical reserves, it can be said to be a great help to Yuguo, who is now slowly turning to the cultivation empire.

As for the Taoists, they are also quite important to Yuguo.

Zhong Yu's current empire is said to be a cross-plane country with unlimited potential. But these are all imaginary, he just has such a possibility. In many aspects, it is even inferior to some indigenous countries. For example, the state of Qin, which was not defeated before, is much stronger than the state of Yu.

Among them, the strength is not only in military strength, population, and territory, but also in the extraordinary reserves.

The extraordinary power of the Qin State, those martial arts practitioners with high internal strength, far outnumbered the six countries of the Kanto, and even more came from the Yu Kingdom, which even the six countries of the Kanto could not match.

Among them, the secret arts and secret arts practiced by those martial arts people are like the Yin Yang school and the miscellaneous school. The secret arts passed down by the families of these schools have been accumulated for hundreds of years, which can be described as countless, and each has magical effects.

It can even be said that what they practice is no longer martial arts, but a mixture of some methods of cultivation and refining.

That kind of magic seal, as well as Taoism's Taoism, Shushan's witchcraft, and Mo's loser's strange tricks, have all transcended the stage of mortals and turned to the mysterious realm of cultivation.

In some levels, it is not inferior to some lower-level cultivators, and it can be said that it has a full foundation.

But it's no wonder, after all, there have been such existences as gods in this world before, such as Nine Heavens Xuannv, Huangdi Chiyou, such myths and legends are not nothingness.
